annotations.title: Comment on a pull request about threats

description: For a completed pipeline scan of a pull request: post, or update, one comment per threat whose linked code the pull request changes. A re-run with nothing changed makes no calls. Returns each comment's status (posted, updated, skipped with the reason, failed). Public repositories are skipped with the reason 'public repository'. Error codes: permission_missing, role_missing, destination_not_found, already_filed, rate_limited, assignee_unmapped, no_route, no_entry, not_found, invalid, no_company, tracker_error, filed_unrecorded, outcome_unknown, not_attempted, not_configured, tracker_unreachable, unsupported. filed_unrecorded and outcome_unknown mean the ticket may already exist in the tracker; not_attempted means the item was not sent.
name: comment_threat_on_change
